an3.104:1.1: lokassāhaṃ bhikkhave, assādapariyesanaṃ acariṃ. yo loke assādo, tadajjhagamaṃ.
an3.104:1.2: yāvatako loke assādo, paññāya me eso sudiṭṭho.
an3.104:1.3: lokassāhaṃ bhikkhave, ādīnavapariyesanaṃ acariṃ. yo loke ādīnavo, tadajjhagamaṃ.
an3.104:1.4: yāvatako loke ādīnavo, paññāya me eso sudiṭṭho.
an3.104:1.5: lokassāhaṃ bhikkhave, nissaraṇapariyesanaṃ acariṃ. yaṃ loke nissaraṇaṃ, tadajjhagamaṃ.
an3.104:1.6: yāvatakaṃ loke nissaraṇaṃ, paññāya me etaṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ.
an3.104:1.7: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave, lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ na abbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake-sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an3.104:1.8: yato ca kho ahaṃ bhikkhave, lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake - sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an3.104:1.10: “akuppā me cetovimutti, ayamantimā jāti, natthi’dāni punabbhavo”ti.
